title: Add a VLAN to an Existing Trunk
summary: Permit a new VLAN without removing the VLANs already carried by a trunk.
brief: Ethernet48 is an active trunk that already carries VLANs 10 and 20. A new application requires VLAN 30 across the same link. Add VLAN 30 without disrupting the existing allowed VLANs.
objectives: Inspect the current Ethernet48 trunk configuration
Add VLAN 30 to the existing allowed VLAN list
Preserve VLANs 10 and 20 on the trunk
Verify the final allowed and active VLANs
hints: Start with show interfaces Ethernet48 switchport or show interfaces trunk.
Replacing an allowed list and adding to it are different operations.
EOS supports an add keyword in the switchport trunk allowed VLAN command.
The final allowed list should contain VLANs 10, 20, and 30.
